welcome.title: Welcome to ADO Center
welcome.subtitle: Building hope, resilience, and healthier communities through accessible mental health and psychosocial support.
welcome.p1: ADO Center is a community-focused mental health and psychosocial support organization dedicated to improving the emotional well-being and quality of life of individuals and families in Anse-à-Galets, La Gonâve, Haiti.
welcome.p2: Our organization believes that mental health is a fundamental human right. We work to ensure that children, adolescents, adults, older adults, and vulnerable populations have access to compassionate, confidential, and evidence-based mental health services regardless of their social or economic background.
